blockingFinding.actual: After selecting R_RELEASE and immediately scrolling while semantic hashes are pending, the settled published snapshot still reports R_COUNT.
blockingFinding.cause: Paused metadataRefresh increments the shared revision and republishes stale lastPacket; the pending semantic publish sees n !== revision and discards itself.
blockingFinding.contractImpact: A state-changing control can fail to publish its new semantic state, violating the frozen atomic publication requirement.
blockingFinding.minimalCorrection: Coordinate metadata-only refresh with pending semantic publication; never let it invalidate a newer semantic publish or commit an obsolete lastPacket as current. Apply the measurement after the new semantic render and verify control plus scroll/resize/details races.
